programme.title: El Mentalista
programme.desc: Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) y Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) son dos brillantes físicos teóricos que trabajan en Caltech en Pasadena, California. Ellos son colegas, mejores amigos y compañeros de cuarto. La vida de Leonard está por cambiar cuando Penny (Kaley Cuoco), una hermosa mujer y aspirante a actriz, se muda al mismo edificio de apartamento donde viven Leonard y Sheldon. Tras ver a esta hermosa mujer, Leonard tiene una nueva aspiración en su vida, desea que Penny sea su novia.

programme.title: CSI: Nueva York
programme.desc: Investigadores forenses que utilizan la ciencia de alta tecnología para seguir la evidencia y resolver crímenes en la Gran Manzana. El Detective Mack "Mac" Taylor (Gary Sinise) es un investigador dedicado y con impulso propio de la escena del crimen que cree que todo está conectado y para todos hay una historia. El y su compañera, la detective Stella Bonasera (Melina Kanakaredes), una adicta al trabajo y mil usos, comparten la pasión por el trabajo. Dirigen un equipo de expertos en medio de la ciudad arenosa y cinética que nunca duerme. Su equipo incluye a Danny Messer (Carmine Giovinazzo), un investigador nacido en Brooklyn con un aspecto robusto, un espíritu imperturbable y una colorida historia familiar; y el Dr. Sheldon Hawkes (Hill Harper), un médico forense solitario que abandonó una prometedora carrera quirúrgica después de la pérdida traumática de dos parientes. Junto a ellos se encuentra el detective de homicidios Don Flack (Eddie Cahill), un investigador empedernido y duro con un entendimiento rápido, una visión forense impresionante y paciencia limitada con posibles sospechosos. Completando el equipo está Aiden Burn (Vanessa Ferlito), una investigadora inteligente y sexy cuyo comportamiento tipo camaleón le permite adaptarse a cualquier situación en cualquier momento. Estos hábiles investigadores, que ven a la ciudad de Nueva York bajo una luz completamente diferente, siguen la evidencia mientras juntan pistas y eliminan la duda para finalmente resolver sus casos.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Ángeles
programme.desc: La Oficina de Proyectos Especiales (OSP), una división de NCIS que se encarga de aprehender a delincuentes peligrosos y elusivos que representan una amenaza para la seguridad del país. Al asumir identidades falsas y utilizar la tecnología más avanzada, este equipo de agentes altamente entrenados se oculta profundamente, poniendo sus vidas en línea en el campo para derribar sus objetivos. El agente especial "G" Callen (Chris O'Donnell) es un camaleón que se transforma en quien necesita ser para infiltrarse en el inframundo criminal. Su compañero es el agente especial Sam Hanna (LL Cool J.), un ex SEAL de la Marina de los Estados Unidos que ha participado en actividades tanto en Afganistán como en Irak, y un experto en vigilancia que utiliza equipos de monitoreo de vanguardia para vigilar a aquellos en el campo y darles información crucial. Asistiendo al equipo está la agente especial Kensi Blye (Daniela Ruah), la hija excepcionalmente brillante de un Marine asesinado que vive por la adrenalina que viene con el trabajo encubierto; El psicólogo operativo Nate Getz (Peter Cambor), experto en meterse en la cabeza de cualquiera, perfilando el objetivo y supervisando los estados de ánimo de los agentes antes, durante y después de las misiones; Dominic Vail (Adam Jamal Craig), la incorporación más reciente al equipo, está altamente calificada pero carece de experiencia práctica; y Henrietta "Hetty" Lange (Linda Hunt), quién supervisa el personal de apoyo "de trastienda" encargado de proporcionar todo, desde cámaras de micro vigilancia hasta automóviles para el equipo. Armada con lo último en equipos de alta tecnología y enviada regularmente a situaciones de riesgo vital, esta unidad muy unida confía el uno al otro para hacer lo que sea necesario para proteger los intereses nacionales.

programme.title: El Mentalista
programme.desc: Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) y Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) son dos brillantes físicos teóricos que trabajan en Caltech en Pasadena, California. Ellos son colegas, mejores amigos y compañeros de cuarto. La vida de Leonard está por cambiar cuando Penny (Kaley Cuoco), una hermosa mujer y aspirante a actriz, se muda al mismo edificio de apartamento donde viven Leonard y Sheldon. Tras ver a esta hermosa mujer, Leonard tiene una nueva aspiración en su vida, desea que Penny sea su novia.

programme.title: Hawai 5.0
programme.desc: Una reedición de la seria de 1968, sobre un detective en su regreso a Oahu, Hawaii para investigar el asesinato de su padre, el oficial naval Steve McGarret (Alex O'Loughlin) es reclutado por el gobernador de Hawaii para encabezar una fuerza elite de la policía para mantener la isla segura para su hija de 8 años, este escuadrón deberá enfrentarse al crimen organizado, asesinatos todo esto con sus reglas. En el equipo también se une Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), quien fue acusado injustamente de corrupción y su prima Kono (Grace Park) quien acaba de graduarse de la academia.Estando en el pueblo McGarrett también trata de mejorar su relación que por el momento no se encuentra bien sobre su hermana Mary Ann y continuar buscando más pistas sobre el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: Soy Leyenda
programme.desc: Robert Neville (Will Smith) es un científico que ha sido incapaz de detener la expansión de un terrible virus que ha sido creado por el hombre y sin antídoto. Inmune, Neville es ahora el último hombre sobreviviente en lo que queda de la ciudad de Nueva York y quizás en el mundo. Por tres años, Neville ha enviado mensajes de radio tratando de encontrar algún otro sobreviviente que pueda encontrar en las afueras de la ciudad. Pero él no está solo. Victimas que han mutado debido a la plaga se encuentran en las sombras observando cada movimiento de Neville, esperando que cometa un error. Tal vez la última esperanza de la humanidad es encontrar el antídoto para curar el virus utilizando su propia sangre inmune. Pero él sabe que está rodeado por miles de estos mutantes y que el tiempo se le está acabando.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: A pesar de que un ataque infantil de poliomielitis lo dejó dependiendo de un pulmón de acero, Mark O'Brien mantiene una carrera como periodista y poeta. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive.

programme.title: My Big Fat Fabulous Life
programme.desc: "My Big Fat Fabulous Life" follows Whitney Thore's emotional journey after being diagnosed with polycystic ovarian syndrome. The disorder caused Whitney, a slender dancer at the time, to gain more than 200 pounds in one year at college. Feeling trapped in a big body, she struggled with self-doubt and negative stereotypes. Now 380 pounds and eager to continue sharing her passion for dance, Whitney has learned to embrace her body and love herself again. She teaches dance classes for plus-size girls, explores the dating scene, confronts bullies, and wears a bikini on the beach for the first time in 10 years. She also spearheads a campaign that fights body-shaming and promotes self-love and acceptance. To that end, Whitney Thore is no longer letting her fear of people's judgment dictate the way she lives her life.

programme.title: A Crime to Remember
programme.desc: Actual murder cases from the 1950s and '60s get sleek, cinematic treatment in this series, transporting viewers back to a pre-forensics era when sometimes it was more about how suspects looked than what they did that determined guilt. Narrative by a fictional bystander -- who "knew" the victim -- drives the hourlong episodes, while reporters who covered the case explain how the events impacted society. Artfully crafted re-creations play out like period thrillers, staying true to fashions and styles, while spotlighting cultural taboos and social norms surrounding each case.

programme.title: My Big Fat Fabulous Life
programme.desc: "My Big Fat Fabulous Life" follows Whitney Thore's emotional journey after being diagnosed with polycystic ovarian syndrome. The disorder caused Whitney, a slender dancer at the time, to gain more than 200 pounds in one year at college. Feeling trapped in a big body, she struggled with self-doubt and negative stereotypes. Now 380 pounds and eager to continue sharing her passion for dance, Whitney has learned to embrace her body and love herself again. She teaches dance classes for plus-size girls, explores the dating scene, confronts bullies, and wears a bikini on the beach for the first time in 10 years. She also spearheads a campaign that fights body-shaming and promotes self-love and acceptance. To that end, Whitney Thore is no longer letting her fear of people's judgment dictate the way she lives her life.

programme.title: The Brides of Dracula
programme.desc: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.","large":"Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
programme.desc: Fossil hunters (Richard Carlson, Julia Adams, Richard Denning) encounter a dangerous, humanlike amphibian in the Amazon.","large":"Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Creature Walks Among Us
programme.desc: Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

programme.title: Curse of the Undead
programme.desc: A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: The son of a servant assaulted by a beggar becomes a wolfman in 18th-century Spain.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: A mad doctor (Albert Dekker) in Peru reduces a woman (Janice Logan) and three men to one-fifth their normal size.","large":"To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A real-estate man (Dwight Frye) visits the Transylvania castle of a 500-year-old vampire (Bela Lugosi).","large":"The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier) investigates as the vampire count (Frank Langella) scales walls and visits bedrooms at an English manor.","large":"A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: This was made at night using the same sets and script as the Bela Lugosi classic but with a Spanish cast.","large":"Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: A vampire countess (Gloria Holden) in black falls in love with a psychologist (Otto Kruger) and kidnaps his fiancée (Marguerite Churchill).","large":"Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: The baron (Peter Cushing) and a hypnotist (Peter Woodthorpe) bring the creature out of ice, horrifying villagers of Karlsbad.","large":"Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Tormented werewolf Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) calls on Dr. Frankenstein and finds his monster (Bela Lugosi) instead.","large":"Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum.","large":"When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Naughty teens (Elizabeth Berridge, Cooper Huckabee, Miles Chapin) are locked in a carnival fun house with a man in a Frankenstein mask.","large":"Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: A killer follows his injured target (Jamie Lee Curtis) to the hospital on Oct. 31 in Haddonfield, Ill.","large":"After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: A scientist (Onslow Stevens) helps the Wolf Man (Lon Chaney) and Dracula (John Carradine), and revives Frankenstein's monster.","large":"This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: A mad doctor (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked helper (J. Carrol Naish) revive Dracula, the Wolf Man (Lon Chaney) and the Frankenstein monster.","large":"After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: Exposure to a mysterious fog causes a man (Grant Williams) to shrink, making the world around him extremely hazardous.","large":"While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

programme.title: The Invisible Man
programme.desc: The serum that makes a scientist (Claude Rains) invisible has madness as a side effect.

programme.title: The Invisible Man Returns
programme.desc: A man (Vincent Price) framed for murder uses a serum to become invisible, then escapes to find the killer.","large":"Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.

programme.title: The Invisible Man's Revenge
programme.desc: A criminal (Jon Hall) haunts his enemies' mansion after a mad scientist (John Carradine) makes him invisible.

programme.title: The Invisible Ray
programme.desc: A scientist (Bela Lugosi) seeks an antidote for a radium-poisoned colleague (Boris Karloff) with the touch of death.

programme.title: The Invisible Woman
programme.desc: A screwy professor's experiments with a gorgeous model attract the attentions of a gangster and a handsome millionaire.

programme.title: Island of Lost Souls
programme.desc: White-suited Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton) herds his bestial mutants and plots to mate his panther-woman with a visitor (Richard Arlen).","large":"In this adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel "The Island of Doctor Moreau," Edward Parker (Richard Arlen) is shipwrecked on a remote island presided over by the mysterious Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton). Edward discovers his host is conducting genetic experiments, and presiding over a race of half-human, half-animal hybrids, including the alluring Panther Woman and the sage Sayer of the Law (Bela Lugosi). The island has become its own society, with Moreau as its god.

programme.title: It Came From Outer Space
programme.desc: Based on a Ray Bradbury short story about an astronomer's encounter with extraterrestrials in the Arizona desert.","large":"While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

programme.title: Kiss of the Vampire
programme.desc: A professor (Clifford Evans) in black rescues stranded 1910 newlyweds from a Bavarian doctor's (Noel Willman) vampire villa.

programme.title: The Mad Doctor of Market Street
programme.desc: A fugitive doctor (Lionel Atwill) tries to raise the dead for South Sea Islanders.

programme.title: The Mad Ghoul
programme.desc: A mad scientist (George Zucco) turns his assistant (David Bruce) into a zombie as part of a plan to steal his assistant's lover (Evelyn Ankers).

programme.title: Man-Made Monster
programme.desc: A mad scientist (Lionel Atwill) makes an electric man (Lon Chaney Jr.) who glows and must wear a rubber suit.

programme.title: The Monster and the Girl
programme.desc: A mad scientist creates a monster when he transplants the brain of an executed murderer into the body of an ape.

programme.title: Monster on the Campus
programme.desc: A professor turns into a Neanderthal killer after injecting himself with the blood of an ancient fish.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An Egyptian mummy (Boris Karloff) searches Cairo for the girl (Zita Johann) he thinks is his long-lost princess.","large":"A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor.

programme.title: The Mummy's Curse
programme.desc: A mummy (Lon Chaney Jr.) and his princess (Virginia Christine) roam the Louisiana bayou.

programme.title: The Mummy's Ghost
programme.desc: A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

programme.title: The Mummy's Hand
programme.desc: Archaeologists defile the tomb of mummified Kharis, who was buried alive for falling in love with an Egyptian princess.","large":"In Cairo, archaeologist Steve Banning (Dick Foran) unearths a vase that he believes could lead him to the ancient tomb of Princess Ananka. Unknown to Steve, his colleague, Professor Andoheb (George Zucco), is also the High Priest of Karnak who holds the secrets of Karas, a mummy who guards Ananka's tomb. Upon receiving funds from magician Solvani (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Marta (Peggy Moran), Steve and the Solvanis embark on an expedition to the grave site, where Karas awaits.

programme.title: The Mummy's Tomb
programme.desc: Old archaeologist (Dick Foran) recalls mummy (Lon Chaney) at large in New England.

programme.title: Night Creatures
programme.desc: Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.

programme.title: Night Monster
programme.desc: A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

programme.title: The Night Walker
programme.desc: A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: Hoping to find a fortune in gold, a boy instead discovers the horrific secrets lurking inside the home of two murderous siblings.","large":"When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: An acid-scarred composer (Claude Rains) rises from the Paris sewers to boost his favorite opera understudy's (Susanna Foster) career.","large":"Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: An acid-scarred composer (Herbert Lom) has his dwarf helper bring an opera singer (Heather Sears) to his London sewer hide-out.","large":"Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Revenge of the Creature
programme.desc: Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

programme.title: CID
programme.desc: A group of officers who work for the Crime Investigation Department of the police force seek the help of a professional forensic expert and solve various criminal cases.

programme.title: Curly Top
programme.desc: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary.

programme.title: Wee Willie Winkie
programme.desc: With her widowed mother (June Lang), precocious Priscilla (Shirley Temple) travels to India to live with her grandfather, Col. Williams (C. Aubrey Smith). A stern officer in the British army, the colonel makes it clear that a military garrison isn't any place for a child. Priscilla proves otherwise, befriending tenderhearted Sgt. MacDuff (Victor McLaglen), getting caught up in the plot of a rebel leader (Cesar Romero) and charming everyone in sight.

programme.title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm
programme.desc: After Rebecca (Shirley Temple) is mistakenly rejected at an audition for a radio advertising campaign, her stepfather takes her upstate to stay at Sunnybrook Farm with her Aunt Miranda (Helen Westley), who bans her from show business. Meanwhile, advertising exec Tony Kent (Randolph Scott) desperately searches for Rebecca, who he has only heard, unaware that she's on the farm next to his. Tony's search is interrupted by many things -- including Rebecca's attractive cousin, Gwen (Gloria Stuart).

programme.title: The Three Musketeers

On the road, he comes across the three warriors. Athos (Douglas Dumbrille) challenges D'Artagnan to a duel, but eventually all four become fast friends. The Musketeers make an ally of the Queen of France (Gloria Stuart) and find themselves constantly dueling with the wicked Milady De Winter (Binnie Barnes).

Years later, when Juan's fame as a matador soars, he returns to Seville to marry Carmen. That's why his fetching daughter, Nicole (Audrey Hepburn), hires cat burglar Simon Dermott (Peter O'Toole) to steal the sculpture back before it's too late.

Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters.

The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.","large":"As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop.".

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.","large":"Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: A recently divorced woman (Amy Poehler) and her hotheaded sister (Tina Fey) throw a party that spirals out of control at their childhood home.","large":"When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: A New Yorker living with four models falls for a neighbor who may be a murderer.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.","large":"Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.","large":"Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.","large":"Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: After his son is tricked into awakening a cursed Chinese emperor, Rick O'Connell and his family seek a way to send the megalomaniac and his 10,000 warriors back to their graves.","large":"Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy and his team face an underworld prince who plans to awaken a lethal army and use it to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred.","large":"Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: Paranoia spreads among a team of Arctic researchers as they battle a deadly alien organism that assumes the shapes of its victims.","large":"After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: A wealthy family is held hostage for harboring the target of a murderous syndicate during the Purge, a 12-hour period in which any and all crime is legal.","large":"In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.","large":"As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Hired to find a missing person in New Orleans, a merchant seaman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) becomes the prey of those (Lance Henriksen, Arnold Vosloo) who hunt men for sport.","large":"Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Sold into the underworld of gambling and kickboxing, a street criminal (Jean-Claude Van Damme) vies with the world's best fighters in an ancient Tibetan competition.","large":"In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.desc: Infantil
En lo más crudo de la Primera Guerra Mundial, dos jóvenes soldados británicos, Schofield y Blake reciben una misión aparentemente imposible.

programme.title: El menú
programme.desc: Una joven pareja viaja a una exclusiva isla para degustar el menú de un chef mundialmente aclamado. Sin embargo, el chef ha introducido un ingrediente secreto que sorprenderá a los comensales.

programme.title: El cisne negro
programme.desc: Thriller psicológico que viaja por la mente de una joven y hermosa bailarina del Ballet de Nueva York, quien fue elegida para el papel principal en el Lago de los Cisnes. Pero la competencia con una rival comienza a atormentarla.

programme.title: Reefa
programme.desc: Israel "Reefa" Hernandez Jr, un inmigrante colombiano de 18 años que tiene bastante talento artístico, está pasando el verano en Miami. Pero todo cambia cuando después de hacer un grafiti en una pared, Israel se topa con un policía.

programme.title: Henry y Klauss: maestros de la magia
programme.desc: ¡Prepárate para vivir lo imposible! Maestros de la Magia es el espectáculo de ilusionismo más grande de América Latina, con actos que desafían la lógica y la realidad. Levitaciones, teletransportaciones, impresionantes escapes y más.

programme.title: La gran aventura de los Lunnis y el libro mágico
programme.desc: Mar será la elegida, junto con sus amigos los Lunnis, para salvar la Fantasía. Y es que, el malvado Crudo, un millonario que odia la fantasía porque no tiene nada de imaginación, ha descubierto la manera de acabar con el Libro Mágico.

programme.title: La noche que luché contra Dios
programme.desc: El 18 de julio de 1994, el joven Benjamín Sheinberg inicia su primer día como médico residente en el Hospital de Clínicas, en Buenos Aires, cuando, al mismo tiempo, una bomba explota en la AMIA causando la muerte de 85 personas.

programme.title: Un cumpleaños problemático
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos de toda la vida se reúne para celebrar una pequeña fiesta por el cumpleaños de Frank, en la localidad de Palm Beach. Será un fin de semana de risas, charlas y diversión hasta que la realidad comience a imponerse.

programme.title: Una nueva eternidad
programme.desc: Después de la repentina muerte de su esposo, Libby se muda con su madre hipercrítica. De la nada, su distanciada tía Jean le ofrece a Libby y sus hijos un escape: trabajar y vivir en su granja en Texas Hill Country.

programme.title: Fabricando ilusiones
programme.desc: Un excéntrico fabricante de juguetes lega su negocio a su hermano, un general de la armada que no sabe nada de fabricar juguetes y decide fabricar armas. Al descubrirlo, su hijo intentará evitar los planes del general.

programme.title: Love in the Forecast
programme.desc: Mientras toma un descanso de las citas para concentrarse en su carrera como aspirante a meteoróloga, Leah se hace amiga de su vecino Mark, quien le enseña la importancia de confiar en la naturaleza y en los demás.

programme.title: Los ojos de Tammy Faye
programme.desc: Una mirada íntima al extraordinario ascenso, caída y redención de la televangelista Tammy Faye Bakker. En 1970 y 180, ella y su marido ascendieron por su mensaje de amor, aceptación y prosperidad.

programme.title: Bad Hair: Belleza maldita
programme.desc: En 1989 una joven ambiciosa se pone pelo postizo para intentar tener éxito en el mundo de la música. Las cosas se complican cuando descubre que su pelo tiene vida propia.

programme.title: Negra Navidad
programme.desc: Un grupo de alumnas es acosado por un extraño durante sus vacaciones de Navidad. Eso es hasta que la joven hermandad de mujeres descubre que el asesino es parte de una conspiración clandestina de la universidad.

programme.title: Al otro lado del río y entre los árboles
programme.desc: Richard Cantwell es un coronel del ejército estadounidense atormentado por la guerra, que se enfrenta a la noticia de que padece una enfermedad terminal con estoica indiferencia.

programme.title: Al mejor postor
programme.desc: Kendall es una agente inmobiliaria recién llegada a Nueva York que debe trabajar en conjunto con Brooke, una agente rival, para intentar vender una de las mansiones más costosas de Long Island.

programme.title: La gran aventura de los Lunnis y el libro mágico
programme.desc: Mar será la elegida, junto con sus amigos los Lunnis, para salvar la Fantasía. Y es que, el malvado Crudo, un millonario que odia la fantasía porque no tiene nada de imaginación, ha descubierto la manera de acabar con el Libro Mágico.

programme.title: El rey Arturo
programme.desc: Tras la caída de Roma, Bretaña necesitará un rey, alguien que la defienda de la invasión sajona y les guíe hacia los nuevos tiempos. Con Merlín y Ginebra, Arturo tendrá que encontrar la fuerza para cambiar el curso de la historia.

programme.title: Pelotas en juego
programme.desc: White es el dueño de un gimnasio que se ve amenazado por una cadena de empresas deportivas. Él viajará junto con unos amigos a Las Vegas para inscribirse en un peculiar torneo y así obtener el dinero para salvar su negocio.

programme.title: Apolo 11
programme.desc: Una producción que nos lleva directamente al corazón de la más reconocida misión de la NASA, la que puso al hombre en la Luna por primera vez.

programme.title: Mamá se va de viaje
programme.desc: Tras decirle a su esposa que sueña con la vida fácil que ella lleva en la casa, la mujer decide tomarse vacaciones para demostrarle lo contrario, por lo que Antoine tendrá que cuidar a los niños durante diez días.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: Los Jellicles conforman una tribu de gatos. Una vez al año, protagonizan un ritual en el que deben elegir a uno de los suyos para ir al Heaviside Layer y renacer en una nueva vida.

programme.title: Diez cosas que odio de ti
programme.desc: Las hermanas Stratford son muy distintas. La guapa y popular Bianca nunca ha salido con un chico, y Kat, es una bruja con mal genio y arisca, que se ha propuesto rechazar a cualquier hombre que demuestre el mínimo interés por ella.

programme.title: Estómagos de hierro
programme.desc: Josh James y Matt Tebbutt se dejan caer en el río Kinabatangan de Borneo, rodeados por uno de los manglares más espectaculares del mundo. Pero todo se vuelve tenso cuando Josh pierde la única olla de Matt en el río.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: conquista mundial
programme.desc: Los tres equipos finalistas migran a las costas del océano Índico. Dos equipos consiguen comida, pero el tercero lucha por conseguir alimento.

programme.title: Desolado con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Abandonado a dos mil metros sobre las elevadas praderas de Ruanda, Ed intenta vivir en harmonía con las fieras más grandes de África. Rodeado por elefantes y jirafas, ese demuestra ser un ambiente hostil, en donde la comida es escasa.

programme.title: Desolado con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Ed realiza una escalada épica de montaña en el desierto de Gobi en Mongolia. Sin haber ingerido alimentos sólidos durante cinco días. ¿Podrá sobrevivir en uno de los sitios más apartados del planeta?

programme.title: Fear Factor: House of Fear
programme.desc: Once concursantes permanecen en un retorcido juego de arrastrar caballos, rebuscar en la basura y venganza. ¿Quién sobrevivirá en la competencia, mientras partes de animales podridas caen del cielo en la eliminación más repugnante?

programme.title: Desafío x2
programme.desc: En un glaciar y aferrándose de extremos opuestos de una soga, Joe y Cody enfrentan su escenario de rescate más desafiante. El panorama congelado muestra estilos opuestos de supervivencia ante el final del viaje: su último episodio juntos.

programme.title: A prueba de todo
programme.desc: Bear Grylls comienza una aventura en las montañas del Cáucaso, en la República de Georgia, saltando en motonieve desde un helicóptero en vuelo. Cruza un río en tirolina, acampa entre lobos y atraviesa pantanos.

programme.title: Hombres del Ártico
programme.desc: Con la ayuda del nuevo novio de su hija, Charlie despeja el camino de un tramo peligroso del Yukón. Chris y Jessi idean un plan para cazar con armas caseras y trasladan de emergencia al hospital a la esposa de Pat, Lorene.

programme.title: Operación Alaska
programme.desc: Nick lucha contra la marea para recuperar las columnas que empleará como cimientos. El equipo de Brannon se atasca en un camino enlodado mientras trae materiales de construcción. Además Jere y Bel siguen construyendo la barcaza de aluminio.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos
programme.desc: Los Brown están comprometidos con la reconstrucción, y los niños enfrentan la amenaza de focos de incendio agresivos. Pero Bird se enfrenta a su futuro, y anhela vivir en Alaska.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos

programme.desc: El talento para el canto no descubierto de Milo amenaza con cautivar a toda la isla cuando Luca lo usa para convertir a todos los humanos en drones obsesionados con los gatos.

programme.title: Polly Pocket
programme.desc: Polly no está segura al interpretar el papel de Prudence Pocket en la obra del aniversario de Littleton, pero una máquina del tiempo de pockites la ayuda a sentirse mejor con el papel y consigo misma.

programme.title: Topo Gigio
programme.desc: Después de ver la colección de minerales de Zoe, Gigio decide que también quiere convertirse en coleccionista. Pero, antes que nada, tiene que encontrar algo que coleccionar.

programme.title: Topo Gigio
programme.desc: Durante una fiesta en la casa de Zoe, alguien se come en secreto el queso cheddar, un queso precioso y delicioso que Gregory tiene que fotografiar para una sesión. Gigio quiere encontrar al culpable antes de que papá se de cuenta.

programme.title: Mini Beat Power Rockers
programme.desc: Dolores crea una máquina de clones para que la ayuden con las tareas de la guardería. Pero a sus réplicas les encanta la música de los Power Rockers.

programme.title: Mini Beat Power Rockers
programme.desc: Dolores organiza una pijamada con muchísimas actividades. Pero cuando la luz se corte, los Power Rockers descubrirán que la guardería es más tenebrosa de noche.

programme.title: Mini Beat Power Rockers
programme.desc: ¡Una nueva amiga llega a la Guardería Arcoíris, Baby DJ! Ella es el alma de la fiesta. Los Mini Beat intentan sumarse con sus instrumentos, pero la pequeña DJ no los deja.

programme.title: Hello Kitty: Super Style!
programme.desc: Kitty, Frido, Zonty, Pinky y Río forman una banda, pero sus disputas hacen que se separen. Kitty Superestrella debe reunirlos a tiempo para su primer concierto.

programme.title: Hello Kitty: Super Style!
programme.desc: Zing y Kitty se unen a Río en una competencia especial, pero Zing teme que pierdan por culpa de Río. Kitty Atleta ayuda a Zing a entender que Río tiene habilidades para aportar al equipo.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.sub-title: Carrera de canicas / El detector de metales del Abuelo Cerdito / Día Mundial del Libro
programme.desc: Peppa, George, Rebecca y Richard Liebre se divierten mucho jugando con las canicas. / George pierde la llave de metal del robot. / Es el día mundial del libro. / Peppa hace un viaje al festival intantil.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.sub-title: Fresas / El cumpleaños del Abuelo Cerdito / Peppa y la granja / ¡Pizza, pizza! / El mundo de la TV
programme.desc: Abuelo Cerdito y Abuela Cerdita plantaron fresas para hacer jalea. / Es el cumpleaños de Abuelo Cerdito. / Peppa y sus amigos visitan una granja. / Peppa y su familia preparan sus propias pizzas. / Peppa descrube cómo se hace la televisión.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa y George se sorprenden al encontrar sus nuevas habitaciones vacías. Mamá Cerdita y Papá Cerdito les dicen que serán ellos quienes las decoren, así que van a una mueblería para crear las habitaciones más bonitas.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: Wanda les confía a Mo y Sam un cristal extraño. No está exactamente segura de lo que hace, pero parece estar relacionado con el cetro espectral.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: Stella y Jennala se acercan gracias a su pasión común por los deportes. Esto pone celoso a Sam, quien usará el poder de la buena puntería para impresionar a Stella. Pero sin Mo, el poder no apunta muy bien.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: Mo teme verse obligado a tomar 'tutoría de canto' con Amber si falla la prueba misteriosa del Señor Brick. ¡Con las calificaciones que suele obtener, definitivamente no podrá evitarlo!

programme.desc: Comienza la tercera y última de las construcciones, pero no en Corea, sino en Europa. En pleno invierno, un equipo especializado crea un remolcador descomunal que tiene la potencia de 180 autos.

programme.title: Supercargas

programme.sub-title: La búsqueda del pirata perdido de Florida
programme.desc: Josh Gates se dirige a Florida en busca del tesoro del pirata Jose Gaspar. John trabaja con arqueólogos marinos y buscadores de tesoros para descubrir los misterios de la vida del pirata.

programme.title: Expedición a lo desconocido
programme.sub-title: En busca de los reyes Serpiente
programme.desc: Con un posible nuevo giro en la búsqueda de la tumba del rey Serpiente, Josh Gates regresa a las selvas de Guatemala y a la excavación arqueológica de la antigua ciudad maya de El Mirador.

programme.title: Misterios en el museo
programme.sub-title: La hazaña, sopa de arsénico y Spring Heeled Jack

programme.desc: Don Wildman investiga una hazaña atlética, un ingenioso esquema y una historia de supervivencia.

programme.desc: Un analisis de la muerte de un presidente propenso a los escándalos. Además, el juego del vecindario que inspiró a la creación de la lotería y el hombre que salvó a Yosemite. Luego, el vicepresidente que intentó dividir Estados Unidos.

programme.desc: Al borde del fracaso, Josh Harris encuentra datos interesantes en los registros de su padre. Un error podría terminar con la temporada de Jake. Además, un marinero herido necesita ayuda.

programme.title: La peligrosa ruta del café
programme.desc: Todd viaja a Madagascar donde debe caminar a pie a través de una densa selva tropical, túneles infestados de murciélagos y hacia aldeas aisladas para encontrar su tesoro raro y delicioso.

programme.title: El ferrocarril de Alaska
programme.desc: Luego de sufrir un accidente, el aventurero veterano Jim James trata de llegar al hospital en tren, pero una serie de obstáculos ponen en riesgo su vida.

programme.title: Oro salvaje
programme.desc: George y Scott por fin están ganando 1.5 millones de dólares en oro, pero si esperan ver su oro deben vencer las inundaciones, las fallas mecánicas y a los vecinos chinos armados.

programme.title: Pioneros de Polonia
programme.desc: Los leñadores van a trabajar en la zona donde Roman Markuc tuvo un accidente hace varios años. Pero hay un problema para llegar al lugar de la tala y se encuentran con el camino inundado.

programme.title: Gigantes de la industria americana
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX emergió una nueva industria de energía eléctrica con Thomas Edison y Nikola Tesla, quienes respaldaron posiciones opuestas sobre la transmisión de energía del siglo siguiente.

programme.title: Hoteles: secretos y leyendas
programme.sub-title: Crimen imperfecto, la sorpresa, el presidente del pueblo
programme.desc: Hoteles: secretos y leyendas presenta un infame asesinato en Chicago, la comida del hotel que decidió una elección, el hombre detrás del ataque a Pearl Harbor y la impactante campaña de 'El presidente del pueblo'.

programme.title: Misterios en el museo
programme.sub-title: Los huesos de Ben Franklin, la heroína del vuelo 847 y el piloto de Doctor Zhivago
programme.desc: Don Wildman investiga un horripilante conjunto de huesos, un avión secuestrado y una leyenda literaria.

programme.title: Historias animales
programme.desc: João Paulo Krajewski parte hacia una de las regiones más remotas del mundo, Komodo, en el sur de Indonesia. Allí espera encontrarse con los dragones de Komodo.

programme.title: Misterios del castillo
programme.sub-title: La casa que salvó al rey, Juana de Arco, el escándalo sexual de Hamilton
programme.desc: Una cámara secreta dentro de una mansión británica salva a un rey fugitivo de la ejecución; en una fortaleza en la cima de una colina empieza la misión de Juana de Arco, y un escándalo sexual termina en una idílica hacienda de Nueva York.

programme.title: El museo embrujado
programme.desc: Una madre soltera debe pelear para defender a su familia de un espantoso demonio que ha invadido su casa y que ahora amenaza con poseer a sus tres hijos.

programme.title: Sangre apalache
programme.desc: Spencer y Eugene construyen una casa flotante, aprovechando una casa rodante abandonada, a la que tratan de hacer flotar, con un pontón hecho con varias filas de bidones herméticos.

programme.title: Sangre apalache
programme.desc: Cowboy les pide a Eugene y Spencer que fortifique su recinto. Con un viejo barril, algunas cubetas y varios tubos, los muchachos construyen un destilador para convertir madera en combustible, de modo de mantener abastecido a Cowboy.

programme.title: Expedición: Pie Grande
programme.desc: Con solo tres días para que finalice la expedición de Kentucky, el equipo investiga un extraño árbol que podría ser clave para probar la existencia de Pie Grande.

programme.title: Guardianes del pantano

programme.title: No te olvidaré
programme.desc: Kenna, desesperada por rehacer su vida con su hija desconocida, halla piedad inesperada en un romance secreto con Ledger, el dueño de un bar local. Ambos enfrentan peligros, pero Kenna desea una segunda oportunidad.

programme.title: No te olvidaré

programme.title: Exterminio: El templo de huesos
programme.desc: Un mensajero en bicicleta despierta de un coma para descubrir que el mundo ha sido invadido por zombis tras el brote de un virus.

programme.title: No nos dejes caer esta noche
programme.desc: En plena guerra de independencia en Zimbabue, Bobo, una niña de ocho años, crece absorbiendo las tensiones de ambos bandos.

programme.desc: Cuando el hijo de 19 de un pastor Bautista decide contarles a sus padres que es homosexual, se ve obligado a participar en un programa para "curar" su homosexualidad. A través de doce pasos y la Biblia, intentan suprimir esta identidad.

programme.title: Magnolia
programme.desc: Todo transcurre en diferentes lugares del valle californiano: sobre su lecho de muerte un viejo millonario que confiesa sus pecados y, por otro lado, un conductor de un programa televisivo se asoma a la crisis más profunda de su existencia.

programme.title: Vértigo
programme.desc: Un detective retirado de San Francisco que sufre de acrofobia investiga las extrañas actividades de la esposa de un viejo amigo y termina obsesionándose peligrosamente con ella.

programme.title: Volver al futuro III
programme.desc: La conclusión de la trilogía envía a Marty McFly a una misión de rescate al viejo oeste en el año 1885, en donde debe salvar al Doc Brown de ser asesinado en manos de otro miembro del clan Tannen.

programme.title: Blade Runner
programme.desc: En un futuro sombrío y lluvioso, un expolicía vuelve al servicio para buscar y destruir a un grupo de androides que fingen ser humanos para, integrados en la sociedad, encontrar a su creador y matarlo.

programme.title: El primer hombre
programme.desc: Un relato en primera persona que explora el sacrificio y el precio que representó, tanto para Neil Armstrong como para Estados Unidos, una de las misiones más peligrosas de la historia: la llegada del hombre a la Luna.

programme.title: Exterminio
programme.desc: Un poderoso virus es liberado en Gran Bretaña. En veintiocho días el país entero está infectado y un puñado de supervivientes tratan de salvar su vida, dándose cuenta de que el virus mortal no es la única cosa que los amenaza sobre ellos.

programme.title: Los colonos
programme.desc: Un mestizo chileno, un militar inglés y un mercenario estadounidense emprenden una expedición para reclamar las tierras que el Estado ha otorgado a José Menéndez. Pero la expedición se transforma en una violenta cacería de nativos.

programme.title: Undertone: Frecuencia maldita

programme.title: Fear Factor: House of Fear

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
